text: The **Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC) dataset (v1.13)** detected the 2021 tree-cover loss. It identified **81.3 hectares** of stand-replacing loss within the asset, corroborated by the **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) dataset**, which confirmed forest presence in 2020 over **98% of the affected area**. The **MGAP 2021 forest map** further classified the area as planted forest (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), but did not determine the cause of the loss. The Hansen dataset is the primary source for the year of the event.
